description:
Overview: This silicone oil brush is a versatile kitchen tool for applying oil, butter, marinades and sauces when grilling, baking or cooking on the stovetop. It is suitable for home cooks and busy kitchens that want simple, reusable basting and pastry tools.

Material & Safety: Made from food-grade silicone with a BPA-free plastic handle, the brush is designed for safe contact with a wide range of ingredients. The silicone bristles help distribute liquids evenly over pans, baking trays, meats and pastries.

Heat Resistance: The brush is rated to handle high temperatures up to around 446°F (230°C), making it suitable for tasks near grills, ovens and hot cookware within typical kitchen use.

Design & Comfort: An ergonomic handle aims to provide a comfortable, non-slip grip while you work over the stove or grill. Flexible yet durable bristles are designed to resist shedding and maintain their shape with proper use.

Cleaning & Reuse: The brush can be cleaned with regular dishwashing methods and is described as dishwasher safe, making it easy to reuse instead of disposable alternatives. This helps keep it ready for everyday cooking, baking and BBQ sessions.
